title: L Layout Interview
eyebrow: GUI.Forms · stage L · dynamic layout · interview round 1
lede: Stage L brings flex, grid and flow layout to GUI.Forms as engine containers, checked against Chromium as a test oracle. The plan is in planning/stages/L-layout/PLAN.md (PR #322). Section A holds the decisions that are yours, including the Chromium download; section B holds CSS fidelity calls where I would accept the plan’s recommendations. Your answers are kept in this browser; save them to a file or copy the record back to the coordinating session.
context_html:
Where L stands

Already decided (2026-10-13): the fidelity oracle lives in this repository under tools/, and Chromium is a test oracle only, never called by GUI.Forms at import or run time. Layout belongs to forms and the engine, never to themes. Standing rules apply: work bounded by effort, our engine as the reference.

The plan: three containers over one shared solver library in the core, min- and max-content queries with a per-control measure cache, layout boundaries, right-to-left, text-driven sizes, effort bounds as counts, and how form documents and the interface builder declare layouts. Phases L0 to L7, about 17 to 20 PRs.
footer_html: They become owner decisions in planning/stages/L-layout/README.md, and the L worker builds L0 onward, each phase as its own PR with its gate. Nothing is downloaded unless you approve it here.
